text: I am making a CFPB complaint against Possible Finance INC and all 3 credit reporting bureaus. On XX/XX/XXXX, Possible Finance INC reported a charge off as a major derogatory mark on my credit report to XXXX in the amount of {$290.00}. Per IRS Publication 4681, Charge offs on credit report are certificates of indebtedness which becomes income and income can not be reported to your credit report. Prior correspondence was sent regarding the issue on XX/XX/XXXX to the Chief Finance Officer of Possible Finance Inc, XXXX XXXX. I am making a CFPB complaint against XXXX XXXX and all 3 credit reporting bureaus. On XX/XX/XXXX, XXXX XXXX reported a major derogatory mark on my credit report to XXXX in the amount of {$1100.00}. Prior correspondence was sent to the company on XX/XX/XXXX where I exercised my right to opt out per 15 USC 6805. I am also making a complaint against XXXX XXXX XXXX and all 3 credit reporting bureaus regarding pure accuracy reporting per 15 USC 1681. As of XX/XX/XXXX, the payment reflection on the report is inconsistent for all 3 reporting credit bureaus. Prior correspondence was sent on XX/XX/XXXXXXXX to the CEO of the company regarding the issue.
